horoscope: With Venus in your solar eighth house these days, dear Aries, you’re in a fine position to manage your emotions and personal life. A rational, light approach to heavier topics can help you make sense of things and reach agreements with others. With money and love, you’re more strategic and observant than spontaneous. Today, however, it can be a challenge to maintain a healthy distance from problem areas, as a Venus-Pluto square intensifies things. You may not be on the same wavelength with someone, or you may receive mixed signals. Watch for the tendency to read a little too much into what’s happening around you. People probably do have hidden agendas, but it’s best not to focus too intensely on the negative. This aspect tends to stir up doubts and inner resentments or rumblings. Internal confusion about a relationship’s dynamics or depth can be the root of troubles now.

The Moon in your partnership sector all day often helps keep things on the up and up, dear Taurus, but a Venus-Pluto aspect today is tricky, suggesting hidden agendas. There can be a lot going on under the surface of things, and there is a tendency to express ourselves in indirect ways now. Today's Venus challenges can bring some complicated feelings or interactions into the mix. Still, what emerges now can clue you into your fears. If relationship dynamics feel out of balance, resolve to make adjustments so you and a significant other feel empowered by your connection. Try your best to replace fear with love to heal yourself and strengthen your relationships. Consider, too, that worries about your work, reputation, or position may be unfounded or exaggerated. If they're not, it's time to work on possible solutions, but take things one step at a time. Watch for a tendency to go to extremes, as it can interfere with healthy interactions. Suspicious feelings are possible, but these, too, can be coming from a place of fear.

It's a time of the lunar month when you're ready to organize, sort, and fix, dear Gemini. Today's energies are loaded or tense at times, however, due to Venus forming challenging aspects. Obsessive behavior is something to watch, as the tendency may be to dwell on negative emotions or difficult topics. Letting go of the need to be right or to uncover the truth is recommended just for now. There can be a lot going on under the surface of things, and it can be frustrating at best and destructive at worst, but also quite transient and manageable. Something might trigger or stir up an old hurt or resentment. Rather than letting it rule your behavior, examine what's emerging now and aim to put it behind you. In truth, you can learn a lot from the messy feelings that might arise now.

Today's Moon encourages your fun, playful side, dear Cancer. Still, Venus transits can trigger suspicion or vulnerabilities. You might feel an intense attraction or impulses from a deep place, or reminders of a difficult time and complicated feelings may emerge. Relationships may not be straightforward right now, and you may sense a hidden agenda or emotional traps in some interactions. Be careful not to hold on to something only because you fear letting go. Unhealthy attachments may become clear today. While this can feel a little uncomfortable, it also brings things to light so you can manage them rather than let them control you. Avoid manipulative tactics and those who use them. Be careful that you're not dwelling on an issue that can't or shouldn't be changed.

Venus has recently begun its transit through your solar fourth house, dear Leo, bringing a more protective energy to your love life and more beauty and harmony to your home and domestic circle. You can be self-protective, particularly with your heart, and protective of those you love. Today, however, Venus is forming challenging aspects, and it’s tricky energy, particularly for close relationships. Interactions can feel guarded, or you could sense that someone is either holding back or trying to control or direct you, which can be frustrating. Those close to you can be very touchy and sensitive now. Focus on breaking out of old relationship patterns that haven’t been very successful in the past. It’s best to work with the energy to learn more about problem areas.

Venus is in your communications sector these days, dear Virgo, and your need to share your thoughts and feelings is strong. Your mindset is positive, helping you across the board. However, tension can threaten to disrupt your relationships and communication today as Venus forms some challenging aspects. It’s all too easy for someone or something to trigger vulnerable areas of your psyche today. Worries about your work or health can interfere with your enjoyment of simple connections, personal interests, and light conversations. Your words may be taken the wrong way, and even the simplest of interactions can seem loaded. If you notice this happening, try to detach yourself from the situation and return after you’ve gained some perspective. In truth, you can learn from what current tensions are stirring up today.

The Moon spends all day in your solar second house, dear Libra, and you seek some predictability and stability. Still, today’s energy is on the tricky side, mainly around money and relationship dynamics. There can be a possessive streak to manage, and if so, it’s more likely a symptom of something that runs deeper than the matter at hand. Fear of not having control over your life can lead you to hold on to things, people, and situations. Consciously allowing yourself to let go on an emotional level, even a little, can be cathartic. Money or relationship worries may or may not be valid, but if they don’t motivate you to handle matters, then you’re wasting energy. Keep your eye out for unhealthy attachments and interactions. Fortunately, transits later today help you see these things more clearly, and you can feel quite equipped to make improvements.

The Moon spends the day in your sign, dear Scorpio, and your feelings and needs are in focus. You can feel a strong desire to start fresh or to begin something new. You're also seeking a stronger connection to the world around you. Today's energies are a little tricky, however, with your planetary ruler, Pluto, in a challenging aspect to Venus. This aspect can stir up insecurities, fears, or conflict in your domestic life. If you feel that people are trying to manipulate you, or that you need to resort to manipulation to get your way, examine things a little more closely. Work on your part of the problem and remind yourself that you can't control others. Or, make it clear that you need to be dealt with directly if others are trying to get your attention. Avoid letting worry or fear of losing power spoil your mood. Family or home life may very well need extra attention. However, you may be better off detaching a little so you can relax. You may be holding on to something too tightly right now.

Challenging Venus aspects occurring today can require sensitive handling, dear Sagittarius. Some feelings of discontent can lead to manipulative or disruptive behavior if you're not careful. A tendency to dwell on the past can interfere with healthy interactions in the present. It's probably better to address a problematic area head-on than let it fester, but choosing a less charged time makes sense. Controlling a conversation or trying to persuade someone to believe something can be tempting, but it won't lead to improvement. Be kinder to yourself by moving on. Later today, however, you're in good shape for behind-the-scenes work, research, or conversations about private matters that feel natural and lead to healing.

Venus has recently begun its visit to your friendship sector, dear Capricorn, and will transit this area of your solar chart for longer than usual. It’s a time to strengthen or form friendly relationships. You’re focusing on equality and positive energy in your love relationships in the weeks ahead, and you’re inclined to seek out different or unusual pastimes and pleasures. However, today’s Venus influences can be complicated. Issues surrounding values, money, or questions of ownership and boundaries can produce tension. Indirect or roundabout activity can rub you the wrong way. Emotionally, the day can feel somewhat heavy. If you feel out of the loop, manipulating or controlling to get back in the game can seem appealing, but won’t work in your favor. You’re much better off if you take the high road! Today’s Venus-Pluto square can point to a situation that triggers a helpless feeling, but don’t let fear or resentment drive your behavior. On the plus side, you can learn something valuable about yourself through your reactions.

Venus has recently begun its transit of your career and reputation sector, dear Aquarius, and will boost your public image and professional appeal in the weeks ahead. This cycle gives you a chance to find more pleasure in your work or responsibilities. You’re in a great place to refine or realign your goals. However, today brings possible tension and competition in certain areas, particularly with those in authority or in business. Personal interactions can also be on the stressful side, perhaps even loaded. For the best results, keep your dealings above board and avoid the traps of game-playing. While you can’t control how others approach situations, you can control how you respond, and sometimes the best response is no response at all! Competition can sometimes motivate you to improve your game, but today, you are inclined to feel put off by it, and it can rub you the wrong way. Do your part by avoiding attempts to direct or micromanage things.

Today's energies are complicated in spots, dear Pisces, and they could stir tendencies toward emotional extremes. You may overreact to small problems and minor events now, but these are likely symptoms of bigger issues. For best results, be willing to face these issues with self-honesty. It can be challenging to remain impartial or tone things down even so, as Venus forms a tense square with Pluto. The desire for new experiences and to move forward in your life can be hampered by a feeling that you can't quite let go of the past. Take things slowly. Today's energies are not very free and breezy, but they're manageable. As well, they can help reveal problem areas, and you'll feel much more equipped to manage them later today.
